name: gsc-mcp
description: Search Console data, URL inspection, sitemaps and SEO opportunity finding for your own sites.
long_description: Connects Claude to Google Search Console so you can analyze and improve the SEO of your websites and landing pages. Find striking-distance keywords, pages with poor click-through rates, decaying content and keyword cannibalization; inspect index status; audit a page's title, meta description, headings and structured data against the queries it ranks for; and manage sitemaps. Runs locally; credentials stay on your machine.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Show the connected Google account and access level

tools.name: login
tools.description: Sign in to Google Search Console in your browser

tools.name: search_analytics
tools.description: Query clicks, impressions, CTR and position by any dimension

tools.name: performance_summary
tools.description: Overview with trend, top queries, pages, devices and countries

tools.name: find_quick_wins
tools.description: Striking-distance keywords ranked by potential clicks

tools.name: find_ctr_opportunities
tools.description: Pages that rank well but get too few clicks

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Biggest gains and losses between two periods

tools.name: find_cannibalization
tools.description: Queries where your pages compete with each other

tools.name: analyze_page
tools.description: Deep dive on one landing page: queries, index status and on-page audit

tools.name: audit_page
tools.description: On-page SEO audit of any URL

tools.name: inspect_urls
tools.description: Google index status for URLs or a sitemap

tools.name: delete_sitemap
tools.description: Remove a sitemap from Search Console

prompts.name: seo_audit
prompts.description: Prioritized SEO action plan from Search Console data
prompts.text: Run an SEO audit of ${arguments.site} using the gsc tools.

prompts.name: optimize_page
prompts.description: Improve one landing page using its search data

prompts.name: investigate_traffic_drop
prompts.description: Find where search traffic was lost and why
prompts.text: Investigate the search traffic drop for ${arguments.site}.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Client ID of a "Desktop app" OAuth client from Google Cloud Console (see the setup guide). After installing, ask Claude to sign in to Search Console.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same OAuth client.

service_account_key_file.title: Service account key (optional)
service_account_key_file.description: Use a service account instead of signing in. Add the service account's email as a user on your Search Console property first.

default_site.title: Default property (optional)
default_site.description: Property to use when you do not name one, e.g. sc-domain:example.com

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide the tools that submit or delete sitemaps.
